name: Turncoat

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.description:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Power Surge
perks.description: Rapid hits charge your next shot into an explosive round that deals additional damage and accelerates power buildup on hit. While empowered, every shot is explosive.

perks.name: Heavy Grip
perks.description:
This grip is weighted for recoil control.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Decreases handling speed

flavor: Pull the trigger. Feed your appetite.

catalyst.name: Turncoat Catalyst
catalyst.description: When empowerment ends, you gain a Void Overshield, the strength of which depends on how long you were empowered.
